//: Geofabrik region key -> the name a given extract STORE uses for it.
Geofabrik's key is the canonical one everywhere in this codebase; a store
that spells a region differently is reconciled here rather than in code, so
a new store or a renamed region is a config edit, not a release.
Only the FIRST path segment is remapped (a continent); deeper segments are
passed through, since stores agree on country/state names.
Override the whole file with FW_OSM_REGION_ALIASES=/path/to.json.
A store absent here needs no remapping (identity).
